g.text: Harder recoveries exposed the same limits in both profiles

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526277

g.text: 4 / 16 successful episodes · 12 target rescues · 321 valid native replies

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182536

g.text: Success = five new target gate credits before rescue. Two repeats per state, profile and delay condition.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526277

g.text: Every state had a separately replayed legal recovery at 200 ms and 1,200 ms response cadences.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526277

g.text: Free witnesses were never supplied to the model or used as a paid fallback.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526277

g.text: The earlier +500 ms timing advantage did not establish a general geometry benefit. Small, selected state bank;

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526277

g.text: native API latency varied. These are recovery episodes, not full races. Study 0082 · 24 Oct 2026 (Pacific)
